descriptionHtml:
Egg-crate foam. Fleece on top. One corner cut open.

Braithwaite is an orthopaedic chaise dog bed for small and medium dogs, with an egg-crate foam core, fleece on top and a waterproof lining. The bolster runs round the perimeter with one corner left open.

Watch a small dog get into a bed with sides. Two front feet go on the edge, then a pause while they work out the rest. Some manage it in one movement. Plenty give up and sleep pressed against the outside of it instead.

Braithwaite keeps the raised edge nearly the whole way round and cuts one corner away. There is a flat line to walk in on, and a wall to settle against once they are down.

What they get

  • A bolstered perimeter: An edge to lean into almost the whole way round.
  • One open chaise corner: A flat way in that takes no effort to cross.
  • A profiled egg-crate foam core: Foam that spreads the load instead of packing down under the same two hip points.
  • Fleece above and a waterproof lining below: Soft where they sleep and sealed where it counts.

Best for: small and medium dogs who like a wall, dogs who have quietly stopped using a high-sided bed, and homes where the odd accident happens.

Why it is worth the money

Two of the things that decide how long a bed lasts are invisible in a photograph, and at £155 you are paying for both. The lining is what stands between one bad night and a bin bag. Profiled foam is what stops the middle going flat by spring. The fleece is the part your dog notices.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

One thing we will not do is guess. We do not publish outside measurements for Braithwaite and we are not going to invent them. It is built around small and medium dogs, so send us their breed and weight before you order and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Size and fit

One size, suited to small and medium dogs. The bolstered perimeter takes up part of the outside footprint, so measure them curled up as well as stretched out.

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

If your dog is large rather than medium, Esthwaite is the same chaise idea at 112 × 84 × 15cm with two sides fully open.

Everyday care

Follow the sewn-in care label on the cover. Wipe the lining with a damp cloth. Air-dry everything fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

How can I judge the fit with no measurements published?

Send us the breed, the weight and how they sleep. We will say honestly whether Braithwaite suits them or point you at something larger.

Where does the waterproof lining sit?

It wraps the foam, underneath the fleece. The part you can see stays soft and the part you cannot replace stays dry.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.
